response_text: These two mechanisms work together because the context switching is the same process for both, they simply have different ways of triggering the context switch. In the case of the yielding thread, the thread function requests a system call to do the context switch. In the case of the time-based thread, the OS allows the thread to run for a predetermined amount of time before Sys_Tick_Handler triggers the the context switch.\n
